messages:
maria: Heads up — PulsarWorks invoice inv_2026_1305 attempted capture partially succeeded. Gateway captured €3,000 of €8,500 (partial_capture flag true). Remaining €5,500 failed with decline code 430 (daily capture limit). Customer on annual plan with mid-cycle add-ons. Need ops + finance on fallback plan.
payments-bot: webhook: partial_capture invoice=inv_2026_1305 captured_amount_cents=300000 remaining_cents=550000 gateway=gateway-eu code=430
jon: Ops note: partial captures usually mean acquirer allowed an auth for part of amount or our capture window hit a limit. I'll query acquirer and check if we can reattempt remaining capture now or need fresh auth.
nora: Finance: since it's partial, revenue recognition for €3,000 only. We need to (1) create an outstanding balance invoice for €5,500, (2) offer customer split-payment options or wire. For amounts >€5k we need PR if they request a manual wire.
maria: Customer emailed saying their card has a per-day cap and they'll either (A) top up with a second card, or (B) wire remainder today. They asked for a payment link that allows split payment.
ashley: Support ticket S-11022 created: https://zendesk.redwood/s/11022 — asked customer if they want hosted-pay split or wire instructions. Paused dunning for this invoice and marked note 'partial capture - awaiting customer choice'.
oliver: Sales confirms customer prefers split-pay: card for €3,000 (already captured) + wire for remainder. They want invoice updated so their AP team can issue a single wire with reference.
nora: Ok finance process: create a child invoice inv_2026_1305-1 for outstanding €5,500 and mark parent as partially_paid. Child invoice payment_method=wire by default. Require KYC and PO number on wire PR. Use https://internal.redwood/finance/wires.
jon: Ops: to avoid double capture, do not reattempt card capture on the child invoice. Update payment intent metadata to reflect partial_capture=true and linked_invoice=inv_2026_1305-1. Command to update invoice metadata below.
jon: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/payments/update-invoice \ 
  -d '{"invoice_id":"inv_2026_1305","metadata":{"partial_capture":"true","linked_invoice":"inv_2026_1305-1"}}' \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $PAYMENT_OPS_TOKEN'
```
maria: For reconciliation: add AR note and set invoice.status = "partial_paid". Create a ledger hold so revenue only recognized on amounts cleared. Finance: tag the child invoice with original invoice id for audit.
nora: Will do. Adding GL hold and creating child invoice now. Also confirming wire threshold — since €5,500 > €5k need manager sign-off. I will approve on this case; will require completed wire PR and beneficiary verification before release.
ashley: Customer replied with PO# PW-4982 and says AP will wire today. Sent wire instructions form and asked for beneficiary exact name and bank reference. Ticket updated.
payments-bot: action: created invoice inv_2026_1305-1 amount_cents=550000 status=awaiting_payment method=wire linked_parent=inv_2026_1305
jon: Once PR and KYC are attached, finance will release bank details. Ops will set child invoice to pending_manual_payment and update the dashboard. Use this command to mark status: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/payments/update-invoice \ 
  -d '{"invoice_id":"inv_2026_1305-1","status":"pending_manual_payment","payment_method":"wire"}' \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $PAYMENT_OPS_TOKEN'
```
maria: Also check refunds: if the customer already attempted a second card charge and we accidentally captured, we need to issue a refund. For now no second capture occurred.
oliver: I'll notify customer AP to include invoice id inv_2026_1305-1 as payment reference and confirm when wire is sent.
nora: Noted. I'll approve the wire once PR submitted and KYC matched. Finance will recognize revenue after funds clear.
maria: Summary: (1) Child invoice created for €5,500 (nora), (2) support awaiting AP confirmation (ashley/oliver), (3) ops won't reattempt card capture until linked (jon), (4) finance will approve wire on PR and clear funds before revenue recognition. Follow-up in 6 hours. :thumbsup:
